subject: Northbridge private deploy: networking certification and Day-Zero runbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@northbridgelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Northbridge private deploy: networking certification and Day-Zero runbook

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive kickoff yesterday. Per our intake we pulled together a concise certification checklist and a proposed Day‑Zero runbook so your infra team can validate connectivity before the scheduled smoke test. Attaching the working manifest (northbridge-mop.xlsx) and a quick network diagram placeholder (nb-network-diagram-v1.pdf).

High-level asks for your networking/security team:
- Provide final network diagram with AZ/subnet mapping, NAT/GW endpoints, and any SR-IOV or NIC load‑balancer constraints.
- Confirm public egress pattern: will outbound traffic originate from a single set of static egress IPs or use multiple dynamic addresses? We need an IP allowlist.
- KMS integration: is DataLock (kms-support@datalock.io) your key provider or do you manage a customer‑controlled HSM? We need TLS + client certs if mutual auth is required.
- SOC2 evidence: if you can share the control owner for access logs and retention policy that would speed our security attestation.

Day‑Zero proposed milestones (short):
1) Access provisioning (IAM/service account/API key exchange)
2) Network allowlist + routing validation (ping/tcp traceroutes to model endpoints)
3) KMS handshake and test encrypt/decrypt
4) Canary inference with 5 test prompts (latency & token accounting)
5) Post‑canary rollback criteria and support on‑call

Can you confirm an internal point of contact from Networking and Procurement for PO routing? We tentatively have a smoke test window week of Jun 16 — let me know constraints.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0183

Attachments: northbridge-mop.xlsx, nb-network-diagram-v1.pdf

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@northbridgelabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@northbridgelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge private deploy: networking certification and Day-Zero runbook

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the checklist and clear milestones. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Network diagram: attached is a revised PDF we maintain internally. Our environment uses two public egress NAT gateways that sit behind a perimeter firewall; we can provide the static egress IPs.
- KMS: we currently use DataLock as our external KMS provider, but for isolated workloads we can provision a dedicated tenant with client certs. I've CC'd them to streamline key provisioning.
- SOC2: procurement will share the control owner contact; we can provide a redacted SOC report and the retention summary.

Procurement note: we need the final Statement of Work to align on Day‑0 engineer hours and the PO code. Procurement, please confirm preferred invoicing contact.

Alex Mercer
Head of Infrastructure | Northbridge Labs
alex.mercer@northbridgelabs.com

---- Forwarded message ----
From: Northbridge Network Diagrams <infra@northbridgelabs.com>
Subject: NB network diagram v2
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 10:55:00 -0700
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@northbridgelabs.com>

(see attached)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@northbridgelabs.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, DataLock KMS <kms-support@datalock.io>
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge private deploy: networking certification and Day-Zero runbook

Alex / team —

Appreciate the quick responses. A couple technical notes from infra: 

- Egress model: if you can provide the two static egress IPs and confirm they will NAT outbound consistently (no ephemeral egress per pod/container), we can configure our external allowlist and reduce routing churn.
- Port matrix: we only require outbound 443 to our inference frontdoor endpoints and outbound 443/22 for certain ops tasks. If you have host‑based restrictions we can publish a minimal ports list.
- KMS best practice: for private deployments we advise a TLS‑mutual auth flow between Redwood runtime and the KMS. DataLock — can you confirm whether you support client cert auth and provide a temporary test key for Day‑Zero?

Naomi — for Day‑Zero engineering, Jasmine and I can cover the initial canary and diagnostics; Karthik will own the routing/peering validation once IPs and diagram are final.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: datalock-kms-integration-spec.md

From: DataLock KMS <kms-support@datalock.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@northbridgelabs.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Jun 2025 07:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge private deploy: networking certification and Day-Zero runbook

Hi all —

We support mTLS client auth and can issue a test key for the Day‑Zero window. Actions: 
1) Alex — share the tenant ID you want DataLock to mint keys for.
2) Redwood — please confirm the cert subject expectations and the cipher suites you accept.

We'll drop the integration spec (datalock-kms-integration-spec.md) into the Drive folder and share a short runbook for rotating test keys.

Regards,
DataLock Support Team
kms-support@datalock.io

Note: we do not accept inbound SSH from external services; any agent-based key exchange must be over HTTPS API endpoints.

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@northbridgelabs.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@northbridgelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Jun 2025 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge private deploy: networking certification and Day-Zero runbook

Alex / procurement —

Quick operational plan to align expectations for the Day‑Zero smoke test: 

Preconditions (must be complete 48 hours prior):
- Egress IPs published and firewall rules staged (confirmed by your network owner).
- Service account keys exchanged and least‑privilege IAM role applied.
- Test KMS keys provisioned and validated (DataLock to confirm).

Day‑Zero run (2–4 hours):
- 00:00–00:10: connectivity handshake (ICMP/tcp traceroutes)
- 00:10–00:45 KMS encrypt/decrypt handshake and logs verification
- 00:45–02:00 Canary inference ramp (10 -> 100 reqs/min) monitoring latency and token accounting
- 02:00–02:30 Failure injection and rollback validation

If procurement can confirm PO routing and the SOW by EOD Fri (Jun 6), we can hold Jun 16 open for the smoke window. Otherwise we should push one week.

I'll keep the Runbook sheet updated in the Drive link Naomi shared.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: none
thread_summary: Preflight for Northbridge Labs private deployment: confirm egress IPs, KMS mTLS, SOC2 evidence, and Day‑Zero runbook. DataLock to provide test keys; procurement to confirm PO and SOW.
